TT is dominant, while Tt in recessive. If something is dominant, they will pass it on to their offspring 100%, with recessive it'd be lower in chances. Is this love? Love was in the air. It invigorated Sambas into action, tail threatening to curl with his vigor. He’d been itching to try his luck with Kindling and he was finally about to meet his match! Desperate to keep it a surprise, Sambas refused to even check out their profile. His nerves were beginning to show, his fur ruffling despite endless brushing. In an attempt to calm his pounding heart, Sambas leaves early for the rendezvous point. The energy in the air that had invigorated him only hours before now turned his stomach over and tied his innards up in such tight knots that he thought he was about to hurl. Shaken by his bout of anxiety fueled nausea, Sambas stumbles to a halt and stares down at his paws. Swaying gently in the light breeze, a bright red flower seemed to beckon him. Nestled between his paws so perfectly, it was as if Aippaq themself had guided him to stand in that very spot.
Watching such a delicate, temporary beauty bob and dance with the wind, greeting the day
